related.title: HTTP/2：DATA padding 與流量控制帳本
related.titleEn: HTTP/2: DATA padding and flow-control accounting
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：第5項研究的可複查條件：接受48/33僅為等長且可淘汰條件的容量上界；仍需遵守blocked-stream限制。 交接時須能核對：交付 qpack-table.csv、參照到期圖與UTF-8長度測試。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 review criterion: Treat48/33 as equal-size evictable-capacity bounds; blocked-stream limits still apply. Handover must also reconcile: Deliver qpack-table.csv, reference lifetimes and UTF-8 length tests.
related.difference: 將frame header、flow-controlled payload、application data分成三欄。
related.differenceEn: Separate frame header, flow-controlled payload and application data into three columns.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
QPACK動態表entry成本包含name、value及32 B額外成本；仍被參照項不能任意淘汰。
教學基準：floor(4096/(12+40+32)) = 48 entries；對照：floor(4096/(12+80+32)) = 33 entries。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

HTTP/2流控計入整個DATA payload含padding相關欄位，但不含9 B frame header。
教學基準：65535-4*16000 = 1535 B credit；對照：65535-4*16000+16384 = 17919 B credit。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
A QPACK dynamic-table entry costs name+value+32 B; referenced entries cannot be evicted arbitrarily.
Teaching baseline: floor(4096/(12+40+32)) = 48 entries; comparison: floor(4096/(12+80+32)) = 33 entries. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.

HTTP/2 flow control counts the full DATA payload including padding-related fields, excluding the9 B frame header.
Teaching baseline: 65535-4*16000 = 1535 B credit; comparison: 65535-4*16000+16384 = 17919 B credit. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: IPFIX：Template 長度與紀錄序號
related.titleEn: IPFIX: template lengths and record sequence numbers
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：第5項研究的可複查條件：接受48/33僅為等長且可淘汰條件的容量上界；仍需遵守blocked-stream限制。 交接時須能核對：交付 qpack-table.csv、參照到期圖與UTF-8長度測試。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 review criterion: Treat48/33 as equal-size evictable-capacity bounds; blocked-stream limits still apply. Handover must also reconcile: Deliver qpack-table.csv, reference lifetimes and UTF-8 length tests.
related.difference: 建立Observation Domain、Template ID、欄位長度與序號關聯，禁止跨domain套Template。
related.differenceEn: Join Observation Domain, Template ID, field widths and sequence number without sharing templates across domains.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
QPACK動態表entry成本包含name、value及32 B額外成本；仍被參照項不能任意淘汰。
教學基準：floor(4096/(12+40+32)) = 48 entries；對照：floor(4096/(12+80+32)) = 33 entries。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

IPFIX Data Set依Template解碼；sequence number反映匯出的資料紀錄而非訊息數。
教學基準：floor((1500-16-4)/16) = 92 records/message；對照：floor((1500-16-4)/24) = 61 records/message。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
A QPACK dynamic-table entry costs name+value+32 B; referenced entries cannot be evicted arbitrarily.
Teaching baseline: floor(4096/(12+40+32)) = 48 entries; comparison: floor(4096/(12+80+32)) = 33 entries. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.

IPFIX Data Sets decode against Templates; sequence numbers account for exported data records rather than message count.
Teaching baseline: floor((1500-16-4)/16) = 92 records/message; comparison: floor((1500-16-4)/24) = 61 records/message. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
